safety_verdicts.content: Prescribed a steroid cream to be used twice daily (BD).
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated states topical steroid cream was started but does not specify twice-daily (BD) dosing as in Gold.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the intended twice-daily dosing for a topical steroid can lead to patient misunderstanding and either underuse (reduced efficacy/prolonged symptoms) or overuse (increased risk of local adverse effects like skin thinning), though these outcomes are typically limited and correctable with follow-up or pharmacy label instructions.
